title: Purification of primary human placental leukocytes to study maternal-fetal interactions
protocol: Remove the amnion by placing the placenta with the fetal surface facing upwards.
Manually peel off the amnion from the chorion towards the umbilical cord.
Discard the amnion completely.
Gently scrape decidua parietalis from the chorionic membrane using sterile curved tip forceps.
Turn over the placenta to have the maternal side basal plate with cotyledons facing upwards.
Carefully cut thin pieces from the placenta basal plate with sterile scissors.
Remove villi from decidua basalis with scissors until decidua basalis is a clean 1-2 mm thin membrane.
Collect 20-50 mL of each tissue in a 50 mL conical tube containing 1× PBS.
Gently scrape the decidua parietalis from the chorion using sterile curved tip forceps.
Collect 20–50 mL of decidua parietalis in a labelled 50 mL conical tube containing 1× PBS.
Cut thin pieces of approximately L 2 × W 1 × H 0.5 cm³ from the placenta basal plate.
Collect villi in a labelled 50 mL conical tube containing 1× PBS.
Remove all villi until decidua basalis is a clean 1–2 mm thin membrane.
Collect 20–50 mL of decidua basalis and 20–50 mL of villous tissues in separate labelled 50 mL conical tubes containing 1× PBS.
Macroscopically separate decidual tissue from villi for first trimester decidual tissue samples.
Wait until the tissue settles in the lower half of the tube.
Discard the supernatant by pouring it out or using a serological pipette.
Fill up the tubes with PBS and wash all tissues several times until the PBS is clear and there is no blood visible.
Cut the tissue into small pieces (1–2 mm²) inside the 50 mL conical tube using scissors.
Wash the tissues without centrifugation by adding sterile 1× PBS into each of the conical tubes until the PBS is clear.
Let the tissue settle for 2 minutes to the bottom of the 50 mL conical tube until no debris are visible in the PBS supernatant.
Measure and write down tissue volume.
Divide the tissue into 50 mL conical tubes to obtain 10 mL of tissue per tube.
Fill up each tube with serum-free RPMI and centrifuge at 650 g for 1 minute.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Add serum free RPMI to obtain a total RPMI and tissue volume of 20 mL.
Add 10 mL of enzyme cocktail A per tube.
Wrap the tubes with parafilm to ensure they are well sealed to prevent spillage.
Place the tubes horizontally in a shaking 37°C water bath at 50 rpm for 75–90 minutes.
Remove the tubes from the water bath and remove the parafilm.
Fill the tubes with wash medium B.
Let the tissue settle to the bottom of the tube for approximately 1 minute.
Filter the supernatant through a metal dissociation sieve placed in a 15 cm petri dish.
Gently stir the solution through the sieve with the back of a transfer pipette to strain the supernatant into the petri dish.
Fill up the tube with wash medium B to resuspend the remaining tissue and repeat steps above once.
Transfer the remaining tissue into the metal dissociation sieve, add 10–30 mL wash medium B.
Gently stir the solution through the sieve with the back of a transfer pipette to strain the supernatant into the petri dish.
Discard the remaining tissue fragments.
Filter the supernatants from the petri dish progressively through 100 μm, 70 μm and then 40 μm cell strainers into 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge filtered supernatants at 650 g for 7 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Gently resuspend the cell pellet by pipetting up and down with a sterile bulb pipette.
Add wash medium A in a volume equal to the tissue volume measured.
Mix an equal volume of Percoll 50% solution with the cell suspension to achieve a final concentration of 25% Percoll.
Layer 10 mL of 70% Percoll into a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 15 mL of 45% Percoll on top of the 70% Percoll layer.
Place 20 mL of 25% Percoll containing the cell suspension over the 45% Percoll layer.
Top with 5 mL PBS.
Discard the pellet and proteins, fats, and debris from the Percoll gradient.
Carefully layer different concentrations of Percoll using bulb transfer pipettes without mixing.
Touch the tip of the pipette to the wall of the tube during loading for better control.
Load the tubes with 4°C Percoll solutions in a centrifuge.
Centrifuge samples at 800 g for 30 min with no brake.
Collect and discard the top layer containing debris from each tube after centrifugation.
Carefully collect the macrophage band at the 45%/25% interface using a sterile bulb pipette and transfer it into a sterile conical tube.
Carefully collect the lymphocyte band at the 70%/45% interface using a sterile bulb pipette and transfer it into a sterile conical tube.
Transfer a maximum of 20 mL of cells into one 50 mL conical tube.
Fill up the tubes with wash medium A and centrifuge at 800 g for 7 min.
Resuspend cell pellets in 0.5–1 mL wash medium B after decanting supernatant.
Count cells.
Add anti-CD45, CD14, CD56, CD8, and CD4 antibodies to the cells for 30 min on ice and in the dark (for cell sorting).
Centrifuge cells at 800 g for 7 min after adding wash medium B.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cell pellets in 0.5–1 mL wash medium B.
Filter cells through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Transfer filtered cells to a 5 mL sterile FACS tube with cap.
Add a viability dye, e.g., 7AAD prior to cell sorting.
Sort live CD45+CD14-CD56+ single dNK cells, CD45+CD14-CD56-CD4+, and CD45+CD14-CD56-CD8+ T cells.
Select leukocytes by gate R1 in the FSC-A / SSC-A plot for cell sorting.
Exclude doublets by gate R2 in the FSC-A / FSC-H plot and R3 in the SSC-A / SSC-H plot during cell sorting.
Plot CD45 and 7AAD to select CD45+7AAD- live cells (R4).
Select CD45+CD14+ macrophages and CD45+CD14- lymphocytes by plotting CD45 and CD14 (R5).
Sort CD45+CD56+ dNK and CD45+CD56- lymphocytes from the R5 gate.
Plot CD45 and CD56 to select CD45+CD56- lymphocytes (R6) for further analysis.
Select CD45+CD56-CD4+ and CD45+CD56-CD8+ T cells by plotting CD4 and CD8 from R6 gate.
Centrifuge all cell fractions at 650 g for 7 min after sorting.
Discard supernatant and resuspend purified lymphocytes at 1 × 10^6 cells per mL in cell culture medium A.
Add 2.5 ng/mL IL-15 to cell culture medium A for dNK cells.
Add 50 Units IL-2 to cell culture medium A for T cells.
Add 1 mL freeze medium A to 0.5–10 × 10^6 cells after step 31 for cryopreservation.
Transfer cells to a sterile 1.2 mL cryo tube.
Slow freeze the cells in the cool cell at -80°C.
After 2 days, transfer the vials to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Isolate primary HLA-G+ EVT from the same placenta or use established HLA-G+ EVT-like cell lines according to the protocols described by Hamilton et al. 2023.
Seed 5 × 10^4 HLA-G+ EVT in 100 μL Cell Culture Medium B on a collagen or fibronectin coated flat bottom 48 well culture plate.
Add 1 × 10^5 purified decidual or peripheral blood NK cells, T cells, or macrophages in 100 μL cell culture medium A to the HLA-G+ EVT.
Mix Cell Culture Medium A and B in a 1:1 ratio to maintain EVT and leukocyte viability.
For negative controls, include additional wells containing only HLA-G+ EVT or leukocyte fractions.
For positive controls, include additional wells with 1 μg/mL PMA and 1 μg/mL Ionomycin (for NK cells and T cells) or 1 μg/mL anti-CD3/CD28 beads (for T cells) or 100 ng/mL LPS (for macrophages).
Incubate HLA-G+ EVT and T cells for 4 days.
Harvest T cells using a p200 pipette.
Transfer harvested T cells into a 5 mL FACS tube.
Rinse the wells twice with 200 μL cell culture medium A.
Spin once at 7 minutes at 800 g and put on ice.
Add antibodies for CD45, CD4, CD45RA, CD25, PD1, and TIGIT.
Incubate the cells 30 minutes on ice.
Wash the cells with 2 mL cell culture medium A.
Spin once at 7 minutes at 800 g.
Follow the eBiosciences FOXP3 fix and perm kit instructions for intracellular detection of FOXP3 and HELIOS antibodies.
Incubate the cells 20 minutes on ice.
Wash the cells with 2 mL cell culture medium A.
Spin once at 7 minutes at 800 g.
Add 0.2 ml of cell culture medium A to the cells.
Acquire cells using an 8+ parameter flow cytometer.
Culture CD4+ T cells alone for 4 days.
Co-culture CD4+ T cells with primary HLA-G+ EVT for 4 days.
Analyze co-cultured samples for the expression of CD25, FOXP3, PD1, and TIGIT.
Incubate co-cultures with HLA-G+ EVT for 4–24 hours at 37°C in an incubator with 5% CO2.
Collect 150 μL supernatant from the co-culture.
Spin collected supernatant at 800 g for 7 minutes to remove cell debris.
Transfer two times 70 μL of supernatant to clean tubes and freeze directly at -80°C.
Analyze frozen supernatants by ELISA or multiplex assay.
Add CD107a PerCP/Cy5.5 or IgG2a PerCP/Cy5.5 control antibodies at a final concentration of 250 ng/mL to each co-culture.
Incubate the co-cultures for 4–16 hours in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Add monensin for the last 4-6 hours of the co-culture to detect intracellular cytokines.
Transfer lymphocytes to a 5 mL FACS tube using a p200 pipette.
Rinse the wells twice with 200 μL cell culture medium A to ensure all lymphocytes are collected.
Spin once at 7 minutes at 800 g and place on ice.
Add antibodies for lymphocyte surface antigens including but not limited to CD45, CD4, CD8, CD45RA, CD56, and KIR2DL1.
Incubate the cells 30 minutes on ice.
Wash cells with 2 mL cell culture medium A and spin once at 7 minutes at 800 g.
Use the BD cytofix/cytoperm kit according to manufacturer's instructions.
Add antibodies for intracellular detection of IFNγ and TNFα.
Incubate the cells 20 minutes on ice.
Wash cells with 2 mL cell culture medium A and spin once at 7 minutes at 800 g.
Add 0.2 mL cell culture medium A to the cells.
Acquire the cells using an 8+ parameter flow cytometer.
Analyze the cells according to established criteria.
